```swift
.sheet(isPresented: $isShowingSheet,
       onDismiss: didDismiss) {
    VStack {
        Text("License Agreement")
            .font(.title)
            .padding(50)
        Text("""
                Terms and conditions go here.
            """)
            .padding(50)
        Button("Dismiss",
               action: { isShowingSheet.toggle() })
    }
    .presentationBreakthroughEffect(.prominent)
}
```
